source_evidence: A limit order is an order to buy or sell a security at a specific price or better.
answer: A limit order lets you set the price condition for buying or selling a security. A buy limit order can execute only at the limit price or lower; a sell limit order can execute only at the limit price or higher. For example, if you want to buy shares for no more than $10, you could set a buy limit at $10. It can execute only if the share price is $10 or lower.
